correctness.rationale: The Laplacian decomposes into J/N, I−E, E−J/N with eigenvalues 0,(r−1)m,rm. Its Padé functional calculus yields two nonnegative off-diagonal types and a diagonal numerator C_{r,m}(z). Recomputed all three symbolic entry identities, all three split-interval positive polynomial certificates for the safe cases, and exact negative witnesses; Descartes two sign changes plus C(0)>0, C(infty)>0 and a negative witness yield exactly two positive roots for every other integer pair. Checked 143 integer parameter pairs. The r>=6 witness and m-monotonic extension supply the infinite parameter argument; finite checks alone do not.
residual_risks: Only equal-size parts r>=3,m>=2 and the completed step; neither stagewise positivity nor unbalanced graphs are classified.
